mo_ta_cong_viec:
We are seeking a DevOps Engineer to join our growing team. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining robust DevOps pipelines and infrastructure to support the development and deployment of our software products. You will work closely with developers, QA, and IT operations to streamline CI/CD workflows, ensure system reliability, and automate manual processes. Please note that this role involves working on a shift-rotation schedule to ensure continuous support for our systems and clients.
 
Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support continuous integration, delivery, and deployment
Develop and maintain infrastructure automation tools using technologies like Terraform, Ansible, or Bash/Python scripting
Manage and monitor Linux-based environments (Ubuntu, CentOS) across development, staging, and production
Investigate and resolve build, deployment, and infrastructure issues
Implement system monitoring and alerting tools to ensure high availability and performance
Work with development teams to improve software quality, release cycles, and scalability
Improve and standardize configuration management and security hardening processes
Collaborate with SAP consultants and developers to support deployment of SAP BTP-based services
Participate in shift-rotation schedules to provide continuous operational support and maintain system reliability across different time zones
yeu_cau:
Qualifications:
Proficiency in English (written and verbal) is strictly required for effective daily communication with international teams and clients
2+ years of experience in a DevOps, Site Reliability, or Systems Engineering role
Proficient with CI/CD tools (GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar)
Strong scripting skills (Bash, Python, or similar)
Experience with Docker and container orchestration (Kubernetes or Rancher)
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP); familiarity with SAP BTP is a plus
Solid understanding of Linux, Windows system administration
Familiarity with infrastructure as code and management tools (Terraform, Ansible)
Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills
Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
Nice to Have:
Exposure to SAP technologies or integration with SAP BTP
Basic networking and firewall knowledge
Familiarity with code quality and security tools such as SonarQube, Dependency-Track, Nexus, or n8n
